items.label: Ginkgo Bioworks press release: Ginkgo Bioworks to Build an Autonomous Lab at Novo's New (09-15-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Ginkgo was selected to build an autonomous lab powered by its Reconfigurable Automation Cart (RAC) architecture
items.reason: The release gives no signing date; it only announces on September 15, 2026 that Ginkgo 'has been selected'. 'September 2026' is inferred from the release date.
items.evidence: BOSTON, September 15, 2026 - Ginkgo Bioworks (NYSE: DNA) today announced that it has been selected to build an autonomous lab powered by its Reconfigurable Automation Cart (RAC) architecture
